# `restore_view_plan_wide_setting`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Re-apply the stack and camera settings saved by set_view_plan_wide_setting, if any.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; absent from the 32-bit build) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xc9360, RestoreViewPlanStackSetting @0x1a0dd0 (64-bit build only) |

No request parameters are read. Only on device process type 2. If a saved snapshot exists it is applied through the same path as set_view_plan_wide_setting, and the snapshot is discarded only when the apply succeeds, so a failed apply can be retried. With no saved snapshot the call succeeds and does nothing. A restored exposure goes through the same state-dependent normalisation, so a code-0 reply does not prove the saved exposure was retained. Registered in the 64-bit build only.

Side effects: Applies saved stack and camera settings synchronously, clears the snapshot flag on success, and may emit a Setting event listing the changed fields. No explicit timeout.

| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"restore_view_plan_wide_setting"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read. Omission, null, object, scalar and array all take the same path. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 210 | Device process type is not 2 | `not supported` |
| 524 | Apply failed because the stack simulator is still enabled while the exposure changes | `function conflict` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Other state-dependent apply failures are reachable and are not exhaustively enumerated. The snapshot is kept after a failed apply.

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":60,"method":"restore_view_plan_wide_setting"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"method":"restore_view_plan_wide_setting","result":0,"code":0,"id":60}
```

Reply, conflict:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"restore_view_plan_wide_setting","error":"function conflict","code":524,"id":61}
```
